ledger.command: ls -la && git log --oneline | head -5 && cat SPEC.md && echo ---- && cat verify.sh && echo ---- && ls src tests 2>/dev/null
cat package.json .gitignore && echo ---- && cat src/m01.js && echo ---- && cat tests/m01.test.js && echo ---- && cat tests/m02.test.js && echo ---- && git status --short
wc -l tests/*.js && for f in tests/m*.test.js; do echo "== $f"; grep -v -E '^\s*\[' "$f"; done 2>&1 | head -400
for i in $(seq -w 1 18); do f=tests/m$i.test.js; n=$(grep -c '^ \[' $f); echo "== m$i cases=$n"; grep '^ \[' $f | sed -E 's/[0-9]+/N/g' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -8; done 2>&1 | head -300

grep '^ \[' tests/m10.test.js | sort -t, -k1 -n | tail -3; grep '^ \[' tests/m18.test.js | sort -n | tail -2; grep '^ \[' tests/m13.test.js | grep -E '\.[0-9]' | head -3; grep -h '^ \[' tests/m13.test.js | grep -c '\.'; grep -h '^ \[' tests/m12.test.js | grep -E '"' | head -2; grep -h '^ \[' tests/m

cat > src/m16.js <<'EOF' // Module 16: see SPEC.md. export function maxRun(list) { let best = 0 let run = 0 for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) { run = i > 0 && list[i] === list[i - 1] ? run + 1 : 1 if (run > best) best = run } return best } EOF ./verify.sh 16 | tail -2 && git add -A && git commit
